identitySignals: Name matches a business listed in Oakland, CA: Harold's Auto Body & Paint Shop at 2126 Market St (Yelp, Yellow Pages and the shop's own website all show this address)
The agenda gives Oakland, CA, and an auto body shop is plausible as a workplace training partner for a Linked Learning career program (an auto body and paint trade)
research.notes: Not publishable. I found no California Secretary of State, SAM.gov or other registry record, so there is no legal name or entity number. Nothing I found links the shop to OUSD or the ECCCO / Linked Learning program. The phone numbers conflict: directory listings (Yelp, Yellow Pages) show (510) 834-2362, while haroldbodyshop.com shows (510) 253-2393. I could not confirm that haroldbodyshop.com is the shop's official site (it looks like a recent template site with no registry or ownership info), so I left the website and phone null. A reviewer should check the shop's registration, for example the Secretary of State or an Oakland business license, and confirm the contact details directly.

profile.summary: A locally operated auto body shop in West Oakland, California. It offers collision repair, auto painting, dent and scratch removal, and frame straightening.
